meta.name: Teen Titans Go!: Halloween Episodes
meta.description: 8 Halloween episodes of Teen Titans Go!.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.name: Halloween
videos.overview: Raven tries to get the other titans to enjoy Halloween again.

videos.title: Halloween v Christmas
videos.name: Halloween v Christmas
videos.overview: When Santa tries to take over Halloween, it's up to the Titans and a few ghouls to stop him.

videos.title: Monster Squad
videos.name: Monster Squad
videos.overview: The Titans want to be the scariest trick-or-treaters in town, so Raven casts a spell to turn them into real monsters.

videos.title: Witches Brew
videos.name: Witches Brew
videos.overview: The Titans throw a Halloween party and invite the Justice League but the witches brew Robin creates has side effects.

videos.title: Ghost with the Most
videos.name: Ghost with the Most
videos.overview: When the Halloween Spirit is kidnapped, the Titans must team with Beetlejuice to save the holiday.

videos.title: Pepo the Pumpkinman
videos.name: Pepo the Pumpkinman
videos.overview: A magic hat brings the Titans' pumpkinman Pepo to life, but they have to figure out how to keep Pepo from rotting.

videos.title: Welcome To Halloween
videos.name: Welcome To Halloween
videos.overview: Continuing their adventure with Pepo, the Titans escape the cold in a nearby castle, where they meet Krampus.

videos.title: Not a Halloween Special
videos.name: Not a Halloween Special
videos.overview: The Titans decide to not produce a Halloween special this year, but soon discover that they may not have a choice.
